result.summary: Resolves Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) warnings across fuzz tests and fuzz utilities in `src/test/fuzz`, as well as several source modules and headers in `src/`. It configures CI to treat IWYU warnings in these files as errors and reformats the CI enforced files list to one entry per line.
result.problem: Fuzz targets and several core headers rely on transitive includes or contain redundant includes. Without explicit direct includes and forward declarations, CI cannot enforce IWYU compliance on fuzz targets and new modules to prevent future header bloat.
evidence: Commit message for 9214667bdf: 'Fix IWYU warnings in the following source files and their associated headers, and add them to IWYU_SRC_FILES, so that any new warnings there fail CI'
PR description: 'This PR continues the ongoing effort to enforce IWYU warnings. See Developer Notes.'
result.scope_notes: A very large, mostly mechanical diff spanning 190 files, primarily modifying #include directives and forward declarations in fuzz tests and internal source headers.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased onto updated base branch with minor include adjustments; scope and commit structure remain unchanged.
result.card: Resolves Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) warnings across fuzz test files and several source modules, configuring CI to fail on new warnings in these targets. It removes unused includes and adds missing direct headers across 190 files to eliminate reliance on transitive includes. This continues ongoing internal maintenance to automate include hygiene. The PR is a draft based on #36844.

risk.why: Incorrect header additions or removals could break compilation on specific toolchains or platform configurations.
